name: Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act (Davao enforcement context)
fullText: PDEA and PNP enforce RA 9165 nationwide including Davao Region. Possession and sale of dangerous drugs carry severe penalties. Citizens may report to PDEA Region XI or local PNP stations. Controlled delivery and buy-bust operations require proper warrants in most cases.
keywords: drugs, shabu, PDEA, PNP, Davao, possession, Region XI
suggestedNextSteps: Keep a written timeline and copies of papers. Ask the barangay or the agency named in this law where to file.
documentsNeeded: Valid ID and any contracts, receipts, messages, or photos that prove what happened
cautions: Do not sign a waiver or quitclaim you do not understand.
recommendedAgency: Barangay / PAO / the agency named in this law

name: VAWC — Barangay and courts in Davao City
fullText: Victims of violence against women and children may file at the barangay for a Barangay Protection Order (BPO), then seek Temporary/Permanent Protection Order from family courts. DSWD and women and children protection desks assist survivors in Davao City.
keywords: VAWC, domestic violence, BPO, Davao, DSWD, women, children, barangay
suggestedNextSteps: Report to the barangay, PNP Women and Children Protection Desk, or the prosecutor and ask about a protection order.
Ask the barangay for conciliation under the Katarungang Pambarangay rules before going to court, when the dispute is covered.
documentsNeeded: Medical certificate or photos if there was injury
Messages, recordings, or witnesses that show the abuse
Valid ID and a short written account of the dispute
cautions: Do not confront the person if it is unsafe. Ask the barangay or police for help first.

name: Theft and robbery — city prosecution
fullText: Theft, robbery, and estafa complaints in Davao City typically start with a police blotter at the local PNP station, then a complaint-affidavit at the City Prosecutor's Office for inquest or preliminary investigation.
keywords: theft, robbery, estafa, police blotter, prosecutor, Davao
suggestedNextSteps: Freeze or dispute the account with the bank or e-wallet issuer right away, then blotter with PNP or PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group.
documentsNeeded: Account statements, SMS, receipts, and screenshots of the transfer
Valid ID and a written timeline of what happened
cautions: Do not send more money or share one-time PINs with anyone who claims they can reverse the transfer.
recommendedAgency: Bank or e-wallet issuer / BSP / PNP-ACG / NBI

name: Landlord-tenant and ejectment
fullText: Rental disputes in Davao City may be mediated at the barangay under the Katarungang Pambarangay Law before filing ejectment or collection suits in court. Keep lease contracts, receipts, and notice letters.
keywords: tenant, landlord, rent, ejectment, lease, Davao, barangay
suggestedNextSteps: Keep copies of the title, tax declaration, or lease. Many land and rental disputes start at the barangay.
Ask the barangay for conciliation under the Katarungang Pambarangay rules before going to court, when the dispute is covered.
documentsNeeded: Title, tax declaration, lease, receipts, and demand letters
Valid ID and a short written account of the dispute
cautions: Do not ignore a summons, demand letter, or hearing notice.
recommendedAgency: Barangay / Register of Deeds / DHSUD or court as the law provides

name: DOLE Region XI — employment complaints
fullText: Workers in Davao Region file wage, termination, and benefits complaints through DOLE Region XI Single Entry Approach (SEnA) before NLRC. Illegal dismissal may lead to reinstatement and backwages if proven.
keywords: DOLE, NLRC, illegal dismissal, wages, Davao, Region XI, SEnA
suggestedNextSteps: Write down dates, pay, and what management said. File at DOLE or the NLRC if talks fail.
documentsNeeded: Employment contract, payslips, company ID, and notices
cautions: Do not ignore a summons, demand letter, or hearing notice.

name: Online scams and cybercrime — PNP-ACG
fullText: Online libel, fraud, and identity theft in Davao are handled under the Cybercrime Prevention Act. Preserve screenshots and report to PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group with affidavits; NBI Cybercrime Division is an alternative.
keywords: scam, online fraud, cyber libel, Facebook, Davao, PNP-ACG
suggestedNextSteps: Freeze or dispute the account with the bank or e-wallet issuer right away, then blotter with PNP or PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group.
documentsNeeded: Account statements, SMS, receipts, and screenshots of the transfer
Valid ID and a written timeline of what happened
cautions: Do not send more money or share one-time PINs with anyone who claims they can reverse the transfer.
recommendedAgency: Bank or e-wallet issuer / BSP / PNP-ACG / NBI

name: DTI Davao — consumer complaints
fullText: Consumers in Davao City with defective products or deceptive sales may file complaints with DTI. Keep receipts and correspondence; small claims court may apply for amounts under the threshold.
keywords: consumer, refund, defective, DTI, Davao, receipt
suggestedNextSteps: Write the seller a demand for repair, replacement, or refund and keep proof of purchase.
documentsNeeded: Official receipt, warranty card, photos of the defect, and chat or email with the seller
cautions: Do not ignore a summons, demand letter, or hearing notice.

name: Traffic and land transportation violations
fullText: Traffic violations are enforced by LTO, MMDA-style local traffic units, and PNP-TMG. Serious incidents involving injury or death may lead to criminal cases beyond administrative fines.
keywords: traffic, accident, LTO, driving, Davao, vehicle
suggestedNextSteps: Keep copies of the title, tax declaration, or lease. Many land and rental disputes start at the barangay.
Keep the citation or towing record and follow up with LTO or the local traffic office named on the ticket.
documentsNeeded: Title, tax declaration, lease, receipts, and demand letters
Driver’s license, OR/CR, and the ticket or photos of the incident
cautions: Do not ignore a summons, demand letter, or hearing notice.
recommendedAgency: Barangay / Register of Deeds / DHSUD or court as the law provides
